subject: Request: Bridge letter to cover post-audit operational window (Echelon Data)
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@echelon-data.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Echelon Data Security Team <security@echelon-data.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Bridge letter request — coverage since SOC 2 report end

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking this. We completed review of Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report (period ended 2026-06-30) and are gating a vendor security approval until we receive a short bridge letter / continuity statement that covers the period from 2026-07-01 to the current date confirming there have been no material control regressions and flagging any notable changes. Our vendor risk team typically needs:

- A one-page bridge letter or management assertion referencing the original SOC 2 report date and auditor.
- A short bulleted list of any control changes since 2026-06-30 (if none, a definitive statement).
- Confirmation whether Redwood's auditor can provide an extension attestation if requested.

Can you provide this by EOD Wednesday 2026-09-16? Also let me know if you need a specific template — we accept either your management statement or a signed auditor attestation.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Vendor Security, Echelon Data
liam.oconnor@echelon-data.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment: vendor-questionnaire-echelon-20260910.xlsx (spreadsheet of specific control checks)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@echelon-data.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridge letter request — coverage since SOC 2 report end

Hi Liam — appreciate the clear ask. Threading Karthik and Marissa in for legal / compliance input. A few quick clarifying items so we get the right artifact back to you by 9/16: 

1) Do you require a signed auditor attestation or is our management assertion (signed by Redwood VP, Compliance) sufficient for your internal workflow?
2) The SOC 2 Type II report we have on file ended 2026-06-30 (auditor: Harlan & Co.). Is that the report your team referenced?
3) For the control-change list, would a concise timeline (date + change + owner) work, or do you need evidence artifacts attached?

Plan: assuming a management assertion is acceptable, Karthik will draft suggested bridge wording and I'll send a one-page PDF (signed) plus a short control-change timeline. If you need auditor-signed attestation we can surface that but it often takes a few additional business days.

Cc Marissa — if Legal needs to review the final language, please advise turnaround.

Best,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Compliance Programs, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai

Attachment: placeholder (we will attach draft bridge letter)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 10:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridge letter request — coverage since SOC 2 report end

Thanks — drafting a concise bridge statement below that should satisfy typical vendor-risk templates; I recommend we send both the management assertion PDF and a short control-change log as separate attachments. If Echelon insists on auditor attestation we'll coordinate with Harlan & Co. (they've historically issued limited attestation addenda in ~3–5 business days).

Suggested bridge language (for review):
\"
Redwood Inference Bridge Letter (management assertion) — For the period July 1, 2026 through September 15, 2026

To whom it may concern,

This Bridge Letter supplements the Redwood Inference SOC 2 Type II report for the period January 1, 2026 through June 30, 2026 (Harlan & Co.). Based on our internal control monitoring and change management procedures, Redwood Inference affirms that there were no material regressions in controls relevant to the Trust Services Criteria during the period July 1, 2026 through September 15, 2026. Notable changes during this window are summarized below and have been implemented with associated owners and mitigating compensating controls.

Sincerely,
[Name], VP, Compliance
Redwood Inference
\"

Control-change summary (proposed short format):
- 2026-07-10: KMS integration (production) & key rotation process implemented — Owner: Infra-Security; evidence: control-change-log-July2026.csv
- 2026-08-02: Minor update to incident response playbook to include vendor notification SLA — Owner: CS Ops; evidence: IR-playbook-v2.pdf (internal)

I will attach the draft bridge PDF (Redwood_Bridge_Letter_Echelon_20260915.pdf) and the SOC 2 report (SOC2-TypeII-20260630-Redwood.pdf). Also adding a short control-change CSV for Echelon's intake.

Two asks before we send:
- Mateo: confirm signatory (I suggest VP Compliance or head of Security).
- Marissa: legal review for phrasing about "no material regressions"? If OK I'll finalize.

Karthik
Senior Compliance Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@echelon-data.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Bcc: compliance-archive@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 14:04:00 -0700
Subject: Bridge letter and control summary for Echelon Data — Redwood Inference

Hi Liam — thanks for the patience. Attached are: (1) Redwood management Bridge Letter for the period 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-15 (Redwood_Bridge_Letter_Echelon_20260915.pdf); (2) Copy of the SOC 2 Type II report (period ended 2026-06-30); and (3) a short control-change log (control-change-log-July2026.csv).

Short answers to your earlier questions:
- Deliverable type: management assertion (signed by VP, Compliance). If Echelon requires an auditor-signed attestation we can request an addendum from Harlan & Co.; that typically adds 3–5 business days.
- Report referenced: yes — Harlan & Co. SOC 2 Type II report ending 2026-06-30 is the baseline we referenced.
- Evidence: we included a concise change log. If you need additional artifacts (playbook pages, runbooks, KMS rollout notes) please flag which items and we'll attach them.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm whether the management assertion satisfies Echelon's intake (reply to this thread).
2) If OK, we'll provide a signed PDF by end of day and route an auditor-request path only if you require it.
3) If helpful, happy to set a quick 30-minute call next week to walk through changes — suggest Thursday 9/17 10:00–10:30 PT.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting you across the finish line on this.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Compliance Programs, Redwood Inference
Mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai

Attachments (stubs): Redwood_Bridge_Letter_Echelon_20260915.pdf (1 page), SOC2-TypeII-20260630-Redwood.pdf (full report), control-change-log-July2026.csv (timeline)
